title: Strange Trails
description: Find your way home, by any means necessary.

objectives.text: Orientate yourself in this strange new world.

title: The Price to Perfection
description: Nikolai must familiarize himself with this strange realm to satisfy his insatiable hunger and twisted mind.

objectives.text: Find viable sources of food in this new world.

title: Heir of Nowhere
description: Erin must change her way of living if she wants to survive in a world that doesn't throw itself at her feet.

objectives.text: Attempt to understand the magical nature of this world.

title: The One Who Remembers
description: Ripped from her life in the middle of a groundbreaking discovery, Voira must now decipher the workings of a whole new realm.

objectives.text: See how your runes react with this twisted realm.
